fieldValues.title: RFC-004 Change G: Add RFC schema relation semantics
fieldValues.proposed_change: Add `schema-member-sequence` and `defines-schema-for` relation semantics so schemas can order members and formalize existing type-definition records.
fieldValues.rationale: Relations keep schema composition and migration links addressable rather than hidden inside prose.
